title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1

Article 5 (Validity Period of International Money Orders)
(1) The validity period of an international money order shall be prescribed by the Minister of Science and ICT in consultation with the head of the institution in charge of international money order services of the other country. <Amended on March 3, 2008; March 24, 2013; July 26, 2017>
(2) Where payment of an international money order is not made due to an error in business by the institution in charge of international money order services of the other country, the period of delay caused by such error shall not be included in the validity period of the international money order.
